all_not_deletable: the overview network cannot be deleted
bad_target_map: target map missing or the same as the current one
edge_not_in_topology: link does not exist in the topology, reload the map
host_link_must_be_real: a connection between hosts must be registered as a real link
id_mismatch: Map ID differs from the URL
kind_site_immutable: the type and site of an existing map cannot change
merged: this map was merged into the overview network
merged_reload: This map was merged into the overview network. Reload before editing.
migrate_first: Migrate the inventory to integer IDs before editing maps and links.
saved_bad_format: map saved with an invalid format
text_id_required: every map needs a text ID
